case_name: K. Saravanan Karuppasamy and another v State of Tamil Nadu and others
facts: This writ petition has been filed by the petitioners seeking a writ of mandamus to initiate an independent investigation preferably by Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) or Special Investigation Team (SIT) into the incident of alleged beating of students of Dr.
A group of students of Dr.
Agitated Dalit Students questioned the Non-Dalit Students which led to wordy altercation between the two groups culminating in an untoward incident which occurred in the campus of Dr.
Both the group of students attacked each other and it is alleged that Non-Dalit Students (Thevar Students) were brutally beaten by the other group.
Regarding the incident, criminal cases were registered against both the groups.

Few police personnel were suspended on the same day and a Commission of Enquiry headed by a retired High Court Judge was also appointed which filed its report and the same was accepted by the State Government and some follow up action was taken.
issues: Whether an independent investigation is necessary to initiate criminal proceedings against the guilty police personnel as well as other persons responsible for the incident.
Whether the petitioners have a legitimate grievance in seeking an independent investigation into the incident.
petitioner_arguments: The petitioners claim that though the occurrence was in front of the Law College in broad day light and a number of police personnel were present, they did not intervene to prevent the clashes and the police remained silent spectators.

According to the petitioners, the delinquent police officials deliberately did not intervene, only in order to appease their political bosses and the police personnel were negligent in preventing the incident.
respondent_arguments: The State Government initiated departmental proceedings against the police personnel and punishments were also imposed on them.
Criminal cases are registered against both the groups of students and they are charge sheeted for the offence of cheating and other offences.
holding: The petitioners' grievance is two-fold: alleged inaction or nominal action of the State and the police on the Law College incident on 12.11.2008 and need for an investigation by an independent agency like CBI, and alleged harassment of the petitioners by the police and registration of false cases against the petitioners.
The Court directs the respondents to ensure that the final orders are passed before the next date and the State is directed to file Status Report with regard to the entire situation.
